          title: Telephone number

            E.164 value is stored and returned.

            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW

            duplicate block. A declared member is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate. This flag is not persisted.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0

I added a read-only `telephoneDisplay` field to the Owner API that formats the stored E.164 telephone for humans, while leaving `telephone` as raw E.164.
